summary: Iteration 5 - validated geospatial support (GeoJSON Point + 2dsphere index + /nearby + /bbox). 85/85 pytest backend tests pass (62 from iter4 + 23 new geo tests). New coverage classes: TestGeoSpatialResponseShape (2 tests: list & single-event GET return location.type=='Point' with coordinates=[lng,lat] in RFC 7946 order AND keep legacy latitude/longitude fields for FE back-compat), TestGeoSpatial2dsphereIndex (1 test: /nearby succeeds implying index exists), TestEventsNearby (8 tests: amazon 500km returns >=1 events, distance ASC ordering verified via haversine, tighter 200km <= wider 500km, lat=200/lng=400/radius=0/radius=99999999999 all -> 422, unauth -> 401), TestEventsBbox (6 tests: South America bbox -> exactly 8 events all in Brazil/Peru/Venezuela, SE Asia -> exactly 2 Indonesia+Malaysia, detected_at DESC sort, min_lat>max_lat -> 400 invalid_bbox, min_lng>max_lng -> 400 invalid_bbox, unauth -> 401), TestEventLocationSync (3 tests: POST syncs location to [lng,lat]; PATCH lat-only updates location.coordinates[1] while preserving lng; PATCH lng-only updates location.coordinates[0] while preserving lat), TestGeoRouteOrdering (2 tests: /nearby and /bbox return 422 not 404 when params missing - proves they are NOT shadowed by /{event_id}), TestBackfillIdempotent (1 test: all 20 seeded docs have non-null location). Direct Mongo verification: indexes on forest_events include 'location_2dsphere: [(location, 2dsphere)]'; sample doc shows {latitude:-3.4653, longitude:-62.2159, location:{type:'Point', coordinates:[-62.2159,-3.4653]}}; 0 docs missing location, 20/20 total. Backfill idempotency confirmed: after restart, backend.out.log contains NO 'Backfilled X forest_events' line (only logs when updated>0). Frontend smoke: local 3000 serves React HTML 200 OK; public preview URL is behind an Emergent infra 'wake up servers' overlay (not a code regression - iter4 confirmed FE works against this same response shape and our new tests prove legacy lat/lng fields are preserved exactly).

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering verified: /nearby and /bbox declared BEFORE /{event_id} - 2 dedicated tests prove they hit Query validation (422) not path-not-found (404).
GeoJSONPoint.from_lat_lng correctly emits [longitude, latitude] (RFC 7946); model field_validator enforces lng in [-180,180] and lat in [-90,90].
_sync_location() is invoked in BOTH create_event and update_event (when lat or lng present in updates), guaranteeing the canonical GeoJSON field never drifts from the legacy lat/lng.
Repository.find_nearby uses $nearSphere with $geometry+$maxDistance which performs the ASC distance sort intrinsically - no explicit .sort() needed (correctly omitted).
Repository.find_in_bbox uses $geoWithin+$geometry with bbox_polygon() (closed ring with 5 coordinates) and explicitly sorts by detected_at DESC.
Service layer correctly rejects min_lat>max_lat and min_lng>max_lng with AppError(status=400, code='invalid_bbox') BEFORE hitting Mongo - prevents creating invalid polygons.
Query param validation: lat in [-90,90], lng in [-180,180], radius in [1, 20_000_000] - all four out-of-range cases return 422 as expected.
migrations.backfill_geojson_location is idempotent by design (filters {location:{$exists:False}}) and only logs when updated>0 - confirmed by zero-log lines on second restart.
Backwards-compat preserved: ForestEventPublic still serializes latitude+longitude alongside location, so the untouched frontend continues to work.
2dsphere index created on startup ('await db.forest_events.create_index([(location, 2dsphere)])') - confirmed via index_information() showing 'location_2dsphere'.
Per AppError handler convention, /bbox invalid_bbox returns 400 with code='invalid_bbox' (tested both lat and lng orderings).
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds 6 DataSources + 20 ForestEvents idempotently; backfill ensures all 20 have GeoJSON location. New tests create+cleanup TEST_-prefixed records.
